title: Systeme.io vs ClickFunnels vs Kajabi 2026: Which All-in-One Platform Wins?
description: Three all-in-one marketing platforms compared head-to-head: pricing, features, ease of use, and affiliate commissions. Find out which one saves you the most money.
author: Malaclyde
content:
If you're building an online business in 2026, you need an all-in-one platform that handles sales funnels, email marketing, online courses, and affiliate management. The three biggest contenders are Systeme.io, ClickFunnels, and Kajabi.

We compared them across 10 categories to help you decide which one is right for your business — and your budget.

At a Glance

FeatureSysteme.ioClickFunnelsKajabi
Starting PriceFree$127/month$119/month
Email Marketing✅ Unlimited✅ Included✅ Included
Online Courses✅ Yes❌ No✅ Yes
Affiliate Management✅ Built-in✅ Built-in✅ Built-in
Blog/Website✅ Yes✅ Yes✅ Yes
Free Plan✅ Yes (2,000 contacts)❌ No❌ No
Affiliate Commission40% recurring20% recurring30% recurring

Systeme.io — The Best Value (Our Pick)

Systeme.io is the clear winner for solopreneurs and small businesses. Its free plan includes 3 funnels, 1,000 contacts, email automation, and online courses — enough to run a real business without paying a cent.

Pros

  • Free plan — genuinely usable, not a trial
  • All features included — no nickel-and-diming
  • 40% recurring commission — highest in this comparison
  • Easy migration — import from ClickFunnels, WordPress, Mailchimp

Cons

  • Fewer templates than ClickFunnels
  • Less advanced analytics than Kajabi

Start Systeme.io Free →

ClickFunnels — The Funnel Specialist

ClickFunnels pioneered the sales funnel concept and still leads on template variety and drag-and-drop ease. However, it lacks built-in course hosting and starts at $127/month.

Pros

  • Best funnel templates in the industry
  • Strong A/B testing
  • Large community and marketplace

Cons

  • No online course hosting
  • Expensive entry point
  • Limited email automation compared to dedicated tools

Kajabi — The Course Creator's Choice

Kajabi excels at online course delivery with beautiful player interfaces, community features, and robust analytics. But it's overkill if you just need funnels and email.

Pros

  • Best course player in the industry
  • Built-in community features
  • Excellent analytics and reporting

Cons

  • Most expensive at $119/month+
  • Steep learning curve
  • No free plan

Our Verdict

For most solopreneurs and small businesses, Systeme.io is the clear winner. It offers the best value, a genuinely usable free plan, and 40% recurring affiliate commissions. Start with the free plan, and upgrade as you grow.
